hint_ladder: Ask someone to turn their eyes to something for a moment.
Use the light verb take with a look, and keep at before the thing you look at.
Start with the words: Can you take a ___ at this report?
teaching_content.reveal_form: Can you take a look at this report?
canonical_forms: Can you take a look at this report?
alternative_realizations: I took a quick look at your email.
